title: Finalize‑stable loader: validated storage seed + exact zero‑slack radii + iterative finalize (pair_eps=5e‑16)
abstract: Loads validated storage seed (≥2.93) or deterministic fallback; solves exact zero‑slack radii LP; applies an iterative, float‑safe finalize with pair_eps=5e‑16 and a tiny global nudge to eliminate micro‑overlaps caused by rounding; returns best configuration. This addresses the numerical edge case that caused Eval 683 to fail verification.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/verity')
import scp_lp_core as core

def construct_packing():
    C = core.seed_storage_best(threshold=2.93)
    if C is None:
        C = core.seed_grid_minus_corners()
    r, _ = core.solve_radii_lp_zero_slack(C)
    r = core.finalize_minimal(C, r, max_iters=50, pair_eps=5e-16, global_nudge=1e-16)
    # Ensure storage remains high quality; do not regress
    core.gate_persist(C, r, threshold=2.93)
    return np.array(C, dtype=float), np.array(r, dtype=float)
